label: Ear length

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #11 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0); renamed in section 5.4

range.endpoint_anchor: ear length / L: 0.40 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.65 -> +100 = 1.05 (fennec pins the top by design, spec section 3.1 #11)

region.mask_rule: ear part meshes L/R (separate meshes on the base), mirrored; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Pinna length as a fraction of L. Renamed from EarHeight (spec section 5.4): it always measured length; values, neutral and span are unchanged, and older documents' EarHeight reads as this slider. The range is sized so the fennec (ears >= skull length) pins +100 - the only preset that should ever pin a slider. A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
